description: This file defines a PHP class StaticMiddleware that implements PSR middleware to check for a specific static token via Redis before allowing access.

classes.name: StaticMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that inspects incoming HTTP requests for a specific static token, validating via Redis, and enforces access control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting ApplicationConfig and RedisServer dependencies.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the middleware process: checks for 'reconmap-static' cookie and Redis token, returns HTTP 403 forbidden if validation fails, otherwise proceeds with request handling.
